sources.publisher: SBI Remit — XRP-based international money transfer service expansion
claims: SBI Remit says it has used Ripple Payments since 2017 and XRP as a bridge between fiat currencies for Japan-to-Philippines remittances since 2021.
The Sep2023 expansion covered bank-account payouts in the Philippines, Vietnam and Indonesia.
SBI VC Trade sends XRP in response to SBI Remit payment requests in real time; Tranglo processes payouts.
SBI Remit says XRP bridge use reduces the need to pre-fund destination accounts.
limitations: This documents a 2023 use case, not current volume or inventory.
Payment throughput is not permanent XRP capital; tokens may turn over and be reused.
Current corridor volumes and XRP sourcing are undisclosed.
